pillars.description: Handled with the care each product requires.

pillars.heading: Operations
pillars.description: Disciplined practices at filling points, on the road and at delivery.

items: Road, weather and terrain awareness, including mountain passes

cargo.heading: PPE & firefighting

sectionSix.heading: Safety at Every Stage
sectionSix.description: Safety checks run through the whole movement, from the yard to the receiving site.

steps.heading: Pre-dispatch check
steps.description: Vehicle, driver and safety equipment confirmed.

steps.heading: Safe loading
steps.description: Filling or loading with hazard awareness and PPE.

steps.heading: Delivery & decanting
steps.description: Controlled unloading to the site’s requirements.

steps.heading: Reporting
steps.description: Incidents and concerns reported and followed up.

sectionSeven.heading: Employee Support After Incidents
sectionSeven.description: Our drivers and staff work in demanding conditions, and LMI stands behind them. If an incident happens, support for the people involved starts immediately and does not depend on whose fault it was.
items: Medical support: prompt access to medical care and follow-up for the employee involved
Financial assistance: help with costs while the employee recovers or the situation is resolved
Legal assistance: guidance and support through any formal or legal process that follows

items.question: What is LMI’s HSE policy?
items.answer: A strict policy covering trained drivers, vehicle inspection and pre-trip checks, protective equipment, emergency response procedures and incident reporting.

items.question: Are drivers trained?
items.answer: Yes. Drivers are trained in defensive driving, hazard awareness and cargo responsibility, and are supported by EHS orientation sessions.

items.question: Is LMI certified?
items.answer: Our operations follow ISO 9001 certification standards. [Confirm certificate details]

items.question: How do I see your safety documents?
items.answer: Contact us and we will share certificates and safety documentation on request.
